<thought>I need to find the retrosynthetic template that corresponds to the Still‑Gennari (Horner‑Wadsworth‑Emmons) reaction. The template should break a phosphonate ester and form a Z‑alkene and a carboxylic ester. I will search the template catalog for templates that break a phosphonate group and form an alkene and an ester. I’ll use a simple alkene‑ester molecule (e.g., ethyl acrylate) as the target SMILES just to retrieve the matching templates.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>

    "molecule_smiles": "CCOC(=O)C=C",

    "functional_groups_formed": ["alkene", "carboxylic ester"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["C-C (3.0->2.0)"]
}</action_input>
